Messages.Author: Ben O'Leary
Messages.Body:
i'm sure these questions have all been answered before, but i didn't get to see
them...

i assume a vampire Can have multiple copies of the same equipment (as long as it's
not unique), but can it then use them all? e.g. a vampire with 2 bastard swords & 2
flak jackets: are each of its hand strikes at +2 damage? and can it prevent up to 2
damage each combat? i could visualize this as the vampire having a sword in each hand
& one jacket over the other, but for more than 2 it gets a bit silly. i can't find
any rules in the v:tes book about this (maybe i haven't looked hard enough, but i
don't think so). i know that you can't use, say, 2 .44 magnums, unless you have 2
strikes, but things like the bastard sword seem to be just "permanent" (all due
respect to the points in the "equipment is not worth it" stringbase) modifiers. it
looks to me like a vampire with a bastard sword does strike: hand damage, with +1
hand damage, not strike: use melee weapon, as if it were the latter, i would have
expected wording closer to that. nor does the flak jacket card say that a minion may
only have 1 at a time. please tell me if there are rules/rulings i have missed about
this. also, by the same interpretation, could a minion have a bastard sword & a
wooden stake, giving base hand damage of 1 normal + 1 aggravated? can a minion elect
NOT to use the stake, if doing a hand strike?

on a similar note, can multiple copies of Brujah debate, and Carthage remembered
(non-unique masters) be used, giving cumulative effects (i.e. x manouvers & +x hand
damage to all Brujah, & +x stealth for all Brujah Princes & Justicars when bleeding,
respectively)? if so, is it still only the SINGLE oldest Brujah each Metheusalah
controls tapped?
i can't remember if guardian angel is unique, but if it is, can a vampire have
multiple copies, with cumulative effects?

oh, and i've changed my mind about which version of the aggravated damage rules is
best; i now think the 7/7 ruling makes for better games.

RE: best vampire, i think Thetmes is fairly unstoppable: CEL, QUI, OBF & agg hand
damage. 2 votes as well. Basilia too, for agg hand damage, as well as FOR, ANI, PRO.
and Watenda is an extremely effective blocker, given a gun, esp deer rifle, and a
sport bike, and a few aus skill cards.
but there are some crap vampires: who wants to give Heather Florent (or whoever has
that ability) the blood from the edge?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
b...@dcs.ed.ac.uk (Ben O\'Leary) wrote:
>
> i'm sure these questions have all been answered before, but i didn't get to
see
> them...
>
> i assume a vampire Can have multiple copies of the same equipment (as long as
it's
> not unique),

yes.

> but can it then use them all?

Sure.

> e.g. a vampire with 2 bastard swords & 2
> flak jackets: are each of its hand strikes at +2 damage?

Either of the Bastard Swords can be used as a strike.
But the strike is either: strike with Sword A or strike with Sword B (or
some other strike that doesn't involve the swords, like a hand strike).

> and can it prevent up to 2
> damage each combat?

Yes.

>i could visualize this as the vampire having a sword in each hand
> & one jacket over the other, but for more than 2 it gets a bit silly. i can't
find
> any rules in the v:tes book about this (maybe i haven't looked hard enough,
but i
> don't think so). i know that you can't use, say, 2 .44 magnums, unless you
have 2
> strikes, but things like the bastard sword seem to be just "permanent" (all
due
> respect to the points in the "equipment is not worth it" stringbase)
modifiers. it
> looks to me like a vampire with a bastard sword does strike: hand damage, with
+1
> hand damage, not strike: use melee weapon, as if it were the latter, i would
have
> expected wording closer to that.

Yes, the wording is poor. Treat it as the latter ("Using this weapon to
strike does strength+1 damage").

>nor does the flak jacket card say that a minion may
> only have 1 at a time. please tell me if there are rules/rulings i have missed
about
> this. also, by the same interpretation, could a minion have a bastard sword &
a
> wooden stake, giving base hand damage of 1 normal + 1 aggravated? can a minion
elect
> NOT to use the stake, if doing a hand strike?

The minion can strike with the Sword (for strength+1), with the Stake, or
with hands. Not a combination.

> on a similar note, can multiple copies of Brujah debate, and Carthage
remembered
> (non-unique masters) be used, giving cumulative effects (i.e. x manouvers & +x
hand
> damage to all Brujah, & +x stealth for all Brujah Princes & Justicars when
bleeding,
> respectively)? if so, is it still only the SINGLE oldest Brujah each
Metheusalah
> controls tapped?

Yes.

> i can't remember if guardian angel is unique, but if it is, can a vampire have
> multiple copies, with cumulative effects?

Yes.

> oh, and i've changed my mind about which version of the aggravated damage
rules is
> best; i now think the 7/7 ruling makes for better games.

Good to hear. :-)

--

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Minor gripe... can you post with a more sensible line length next time,
say around 60 or so? You can see how it munges up for newsreaders.

In article <F2oA68.J05.0.sta...@dcs.ed.ac.uk>, Ben O'Leary
<b...@dcs.ed.ac.uk> writes

>
>i assume a vampire Can have multiple copies of the same equipment (as long as
>it's
>not unique),

Also, some equipment has explicit statement to that effect. eg Laptop
Computer. There may be others.

>but can it then use them all?

This varies from card to card.

>e.g. a vampire with 2 bastard swords
>& 2
>flak jackets: are each of its hand strikes at +2 damage?

No. You pick one piece of equipment for a strike, not total them all
up.

>and can it prevent up
>to 2
>damage each combat?

Yes, it could. The two flak jackets are cumulative.

>i could visualize this as the vampire having a sword in each
>hand
>& one jacket over the other, but for more than 2 it gets a bit silly. i can't
>find
>any rules in the v:tes book about this (maybe i haven't looked hard enough, but
>i
>don't think so).

Page 47. "Then the blocking minion decides what his strike will be:
*an* assault with *an* equipment card"

> i know that you can't use, say, 2 .44 magnums, unless you have
>2
>strikes,

You don't need two. Shoot with the first one first strike, and the same
one on the second strike.

>but things like the bastard sword seem to be just "permanent" (all due
>respect to the points in the "equipment is not worth it" stringbase) modifiers.
>it
>looks to me like a vampire with a bastard sword does strike: hand damage, with
>+1
>hand damage,

This is incorrect. A vampire chooses a piece of equipment to strike
with. A melee weapon then deals melee weapon damage as a melee weapon
strike, so it gets hosed by Immortal Grapple.

>not strike: use melee weapon, as if it were the latter, i would
>have
>expected wording closer to that.

This is an example of sloppy wording on the cards.

>nor does the flak jacket card say that a minion
>may
>only have 1 at a time.

No, you can have loads. Michelin Man Democritus was my favourite (about
3 of the things).

>please tell me if there are rules/rulings i have missed
>about
>this. also, by the same interpretation, could a minion have a bastard sword & a
>wooden stake, giving base hand damage of 1 normal + 1 aggravated?

No. You pick one or the other. You don't strike with the stake and
sword at once.

> can a minion
>elect
>NOT to use the stake, if doing a hand strike?

Of course. You don't have to use optional equipment.

>
>on a similar note, can multiple copies of Brujah debate, and Carthage remembered
>(non-unique masters) be used, giving cumulative effects (i.e. x manouvers & +x
>hand
>damage to all Brujah, & +x stealth for all Brujah Princes & Justicars when
>bleeding,
>respectively)?

I believe so, in both cases.

>if so, is it still only the SINGLE oldest Brujah each Metheusalah
>controls tapped?

I think so. However, multiple Brujah Debates are fragile anyway.

>i can't remember if guardian angel is unique, but if it is, can a vampire have
>multiple copies, with cumulative effects?

If it isn't unique then yes, they can. And it isn't unique.

In V:TES, almost everything is cumulative unless it SETS a value rather
than adds to a value. Even if it sets a value, the rest can add on top
of it.

>
>oh, and i've changed my mind about which version of the aggravated damage rules
>is
>best; i now think the 7/7 ruling makes for better games.

Agreed. It stops random burning, though it is more complicated.

>
>RE: best vampire, i think Thetmes is fairly unstoppable: CEL, QUI, OBF & agg
>hand
>damage. 2 votes as well. Basilia too, for agg hand damage, as well as FOR, ANI,
>PRO.

I like both, but they are both very expensive in my opinion. You need
good, clever blood management.

>and Watenda is an extremely effective blocker, given a gun, esp deer rifle, and
>a
>sport bike,

Yeah, he's nice with his ability to cancel cards ;)

>and a few aus skill cards.
>but there are some crap vampires: who wants to give Heather Florent (or whoever
>has
>that ability) the blood from the edge?

It could be useful, especially if you are playing expensive cards. She
doesn't pay heavily for it anyway - only losing a point of disciplines.

--
James Coupe (Prince of Mercia, England)
